contract.description: Tombstone a memory that is wrong, outdated or retracted, and get back whether it landed: memoryId, tome, forgotten and your reason on success. Nothing is hard-deleted: the record stays stored with a visible tombstone and your reason, but disappears from recall and from list's default (active) view. Call it when the human retracts a fact or reverses a decision ("forget that, we do it differently now"), and to retire journal entries after distilling them into facts. Use the exact memoryId from an earlier recall, list or compact-candidates result. A tombstone lands only in the resolved tome: an id that lives in another tome comes back forgotten=false - reads accept tome=, writes never cross. Forgetting an unknown or already-forgotten id also returns forgotten=false - do not retry. upstream_unavailable means the store is unreachable and no tombstone was applied.
contract.name: memory_forget
contract.title: Forget a memory
